newsitem.title: USA: CS Wireless launches Net service.
newsitem.headline: CS Wireless launches Net service.

text.p: Private wireless telecommunications firm CS Wireless Systems Inc on Monday said it plans to launch a high speed internet access service in the Dallas/Fort Worth area in the next few months.
The wireless telecommunications company said it will pursue an aggressive strategy to roll out high-speed hybrid wireless cable modems to corporate customers.
The company said the service will include the ability to connect single users on individual PCs or multiple users in a local area network environment.
CS Wireless is a privately held company primarily owned by CAI Wireless Systems Inc and Heartland Wireless Communications Inc.
